column1: # Delegation action scenarios — executed by scripts/delegation-scenarios.py against the ordered
# Fields (TAB separated): id <TAB> title <TAB> facts (key=value, comma separated) <TAB> expected verdict
# The expected verdict is recorded HERE; the decision that has to produce it lives in the RULE.
# Neither file may be edited to agree with the other without saying which one was wrong.
# S1..S10 are the scenarios the Phase 5 directive named. S11 and S12 exist because the harness
# requires every decision row to be exercised by some scenario: without them the "parent works
# outside the delegated scope" row and the "recorded exception trigger" row would be unmeasured
# clauses, which is the shape this project refuses (M=0 refuses to pass).
